QuestInfo.name: Eliminate the Skeletons
QuestInfo.0: Muirhat is worried about the evil spirits that have infiltrated Victoria Island as of late. I wonder what I could do to help. I should go talk to Muirhat on the top deck of The Nautilus.
QuestInfo.1:
Victoria Island is infested with evil spirits, but you can't give up. You need to eliminate #r20 Skeleton Soldiers#k and #r20 Skeleton Officers#k to stop these evil creatures from further spreading their wickedness in Victoria Island. 

#o 5150001# #r#a22011##k
#o 6230602# #r#a22012##k
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated 20 Skeleton Soldiers and 20 Skeleton Officers. You hope you've made a difference in Victoria Island.

0.0: Thank you for the wonderful job you did last time. Unfortunately, I don't think that was enough to prevent the evil spirits from reaching further. Can you help me once more?

yes.0: Thank you. Go and defeat #r20 Skeleton Soldiers#k and #r20 Skeleton Officers#k. They are much stronger than the Golems that you fought in the past. Please be careful.

no.0: You must be busy with other endeavors. That's unfortunate. I'll just have to look for other willing warriors.

1.0: That was fast. I knew you'd be able to do it. Hopefully your efforts will result in bringing in peace on Victoria Island.

yes.0: Once you make yourself more powerful, I'll contact you again for more help.

mob.0: Go and defeat 20 Skeleton Soldiers and 20 Skeleton Officers. They appear near the ancient ruins of Victoria Island.
